candidates.statement: For short knots, the quadratic bound is better than the 4/3 power bound. Comparing (3) to (4), we see that one needs ropelengths over 79 before the advantage of the lower exponent is evident. If one uses the actual bound (12) we obtain in the proof, which is a complicated expression dominated by a 4/3 power term, then that bound is lower than (4) for ropelengths > 41. Computer simulations suggest [23,35] the only knots that can be realized with a ropelength ⩽41 are the unknot and the trefoil. Proof of Theorems 8 and 9.
